## Ticket

- Ticket:
- Change class: A / B / C
- Auto-merge window: Closed / Move _ of 3

## Player-facing result

Describe what the player can now see, feel, discover, understand, or do.

## Authority check

- [ ] The change stays inside the active ticket and established direction.
- [ ] Canon is unchanged, or Founder approval is linked below.
- [ ] No new external dependency or other Class C decision is introduced, or Founder approval is linked below.
- [ ] `WORLD_STATUS.md` records the ticket, classification, evidence, and window count.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Relevant visual or interaction path reviewed when behavior or presentation changes.
- [ ] No unresolved review thread or requested change remains.

## Founder approval

Required for Class C changes and for Class B changes outside a Founder-opened auto-merge window.

Not required for eligible Class A changes or eligible Class B changes inside an open auto-merge window.
